pages.text: The $(item)Ore Sack$() is a type of $(l:sns/item_containers)Item Container$() intended for holding large amounts of a single ore like item making it extremely useful when going mining. $(br2)By default these hold a staggering 512 items
For modpack authors or simply people wishing to add extra ores see the item tag $(bold)sns:allowed_in_ore_sack$() most addons should be automatically supported
